summary: Dependency resolved from an off-registry URL on an unrelated host
details: package.json line 12 declares its sole dependency, `linker-client-string-async`, as a bare HTTPS URL to `https://artifacts.koliroute.com/npm/linker-client-string-async` instead of a registry version range. `npm install` fetches and installs whatever bytes that mutable, unpinned, integrity-unchecked endpoint returns, executing any lifecycle scripts contained in it on the installing machine. The host is unrelated to any declared repository or homepage, and the content it serves can change at any time without a new publish of this package. The shipped code is a one-line re-export of that dependency, so the manifest line is the package's entire functional surface and the stub also loads the fetched code on require.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
